Kazuhiko Arase — http://www.d-project.com/
MIT licence (see the header of qrcode-generator.js)

Vendored deliberately rather than loaded from a CDN: this is an internal tool,
and the entry-point URLs it encodes should not be handed to third-party code in
an HR user's browser.

Fetched 2026-09-30 from
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.js
unmodified, 56,694 bytes. Kept unminified so it can be read.

It computes QR modules and touches no DOM, makes no network calls and uses no
eval, cookies or storage. Rendering is ours — see qr-render.js.
